core_obligations: The authors construct almost-linear-size anti-checker printing circuits under the stated NP-circuit assumption through relative approximate counting, circuit-list pruning and a combinatorial witness construction. They then use this constructive anti-checker mechanism to prove the conditional Gap-MCSP hardness magnification theorem. The full anti-checker lemma and its implementation are supplied; MKtP magnification, previously known restatements, unconditional formula lower bounds and the separate Anti-Checker Hypothesis remain context, not additional counts.
